title: L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

reports.title: Messerangriff auf Kinder: Täter «kaufte Rindfleisch, um zu üben»
Chinese hatte Tat zusammen mit ChatGPT geplant!
Zürich-Oerlikon: Angriff auf Kinder eines Kinderhortes mit Verletzungsfolgen
L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

summary:
A 23 year old Chinese student appeared in court in Zurich on Thursday, charged with attempted murder after stabbing three five year old boys outside an after school care centre in Oerlikon on 1 October 2024. Using a knife with a blade of about 8.5 centimetres, he severely injured all three children. One boy had a major vein in his neck cut and needed emergency surgery, another was stabbed twice in the chest and nearly died from heart and blood vessel damage, and the third suffered wounds to his ear and lung. A care worker grabbed the attacker's arms, forcing him to drop the knife and surrender before passersby held him until police arrived.

At Thursday's hearing, prosecutors said the man planned the attack for weeks, using ChatGPT to research legal consequences and choosing children as targets. He ordered clothes and kitchen knives, studied anatomy, and bought raw beef to practise stabbing the day before the attack, which fell on China's national day. The prosecution describes his motive as revenge, a need for recognition, and ideological delusion, and is asking for a 15 year prison sentence plus a 15 year expulsion order.
title_en: The man who attacked a Swiss daycare found his victims on ChatGPT
